content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-6|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Workers is a serverless platform that enables developers to run code at the edge of the network. The crypto payment webhook is a specific feature that allows creators to receive notifications when a payment is made. This webhook is typically used in conjunction with a payment gateway, such as NOWPayments, to automate the payment processing. The result is a seamless and efficient way to collect crypto payments for digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of the crypto payment webhook involves several components working together. Cloudflare Pages hosts the website, Cloudflare Workers handles the backend logic, Supabase stores the order data, and NOWPayments processes the payments. When a payment is made, the webhook fires, sending a notification to Cloudflare Workers. The workers then update the order data in Supabase and trigger the payment processing with NOWPayments. The entire process is automated, ensuring a smooth and efficient payment experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators who rely on crypto payments to sell their digital products. They may be based in countries where traditional payment gateways like Stripe or PayPal are unavailable or restricted. The 0.5% fee structure of NOWPayments is an attractive option, especially for creators who want to avoid the high fees associated with traditional payment gateways.
The 0.5% fee structure of NOWPayments is a game-changer for creators who want to avoid high fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. There is no monthly fee, no setup fee, no payout fee, and no minimum transaction volume requirement. Network fees for the underlying blockchain transaction are paid by the buyer and vary by network — Tron fees are under $0.10, Solana fees are fractions of a cent, Bitcoin fees average $1 to $5 for most transactions. For a $97 product sold through the Sovereign Starter Stack, the total transaction cost is approximately $0.49 to NOWPayments plus network fees typically under $0.10 on Tron. Compare this to Gumroad's 10% fee on the same transaction — $9.70.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, follow these steps. First, purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Next, set up Cloudflare Pages to host your website. Then, create a Cloudflare Worker to handle the backend logic. Configure Supabase to store the order data and set up NOWPayments to process the payments. Finally, test the entire infrastructure to ensure it works as expected.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable and supports competitive local currency rates.
USDT settlement speed on Tron and Solana is significantly faster than PayPal.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure, follow these steps. Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Set up Cloudflare Pages to host your website. Create a Cloudflare Worker to handle the backend logic. Configure Supabase to store the order data. Set up NOWPayments to process the payments. Test the entire infrastructure to ensure it works as expected.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the 0.5% fee structure of NOWPayments, and how does it compare to traditional payment gateways?

The 0.5% fee structure of NOWPayments is significantly lower than traditional payment gateways, which can charge up to 3% + $0.30 per transaction. This makes NOWPayments an attractive option for creators who want to avoid high fees.
How does the crypto payment webhook work, and what role does Cloudflare Workers play in the process?

The crypto payment webhook is a feature that allows creators to receive notifications when a payment is made. Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic and automation, updating the order data in Supabase and triggering the payment processing with NOWPayments.
Can I use this infrastructure for physical products, or is it only for digital products?

This infrastructure is designed for digital products, but you can modify it to work with physical products. However, you may need to add additional components to handle shipping and inventory management.
How long does it take to deploy this infrastructure, and what support options are available?
The Edge Commerce Stack can be deployed in 48 hours, and 30-day support is available to ensure a smooth deployment process.
What is the difference between Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Workers, and which one should I use?

Cloudflare Pages provides a fast and secure hosting solution, while Cloudflare Workers handles the backend logic and automation. You can use both Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Workers to deploy this infrastructure.
